shortBulletSummary: Global crypto market cap rose ~1.2% as Bitcoin hits $77K. US spot Bitcoin ETFs see renewed inflows.
Strong tech earnings boosted market sentiment. Fed's "higher-for-longer" rate stance tempers enthusiasm.
US designates Bitcoin a national security asset amid global tensions. This could drive institutional demand.
Japan prepares for crypto ETF debut, and CME will list AVAX and SUI futures contracts May 4.
